verdict.rationale: Browserbase is built to run headless browsers programmatically. The official SDK connects to and controls headless browsers on Browserbase, sessions can be created and controlled via API, and agents can run on a schedule or on demand, with webhooks so you don't have to poll and a terminal-based Browse CLI. Community commenters describe it as a serverless headless browser product. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline integration docs (e.g. GitHub Actions examples), hands-on independent corroboration of CI usage.
